megacorp-pavilion.mobility.1: The elevator is on the first floor near the entrance.
megacorp-pavilion.mobility.2: ADA parking is available in the lower attached parking garage operated by ABM Parking. Follow signage to the elevators for access to the main entry.
ADA seating is available through AXS.com
megacorp-pavilion.sensory.1: We kindly ask that you submit your request at least two weeks prior to the concert date.
While we will do our best to accommodate late requests, advance notice is greatly appreciated.
megacorp-pavilion.mobility.4: If you require ADA accessible seating for a general admission show, a member of our Guest Services staff can help accommodate your needs when you arrive.
megacorp-pavilion.cognitive.1: Almost all of our shows are general admission standing room only, which means that there is no assigned seating, if there's seating at all.
Almost all of our events have a "no re-entry" policy, which means once you enter, you cannot leave and re-enter.
megacorp-pavilion.chronic.1: we do not allow the following items:
Coolers, chairs, umbrellas, strollers, car seats
